name: skills
description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
one_liner: A curated collection of ready-to-use instruction files ('skills') that make AI coding assistants better at specific everyday engineering tasks, shared publicly by a well-known TypeScript educator.
buyer: A developer who already follows this educator's paid courses and wants the same practical guidance baked directly into their AI coding assistant.
business_use_cases: A solo developer installs the skills to get more consistent AI coding output on TypeScript projects.
An engineering team adopts the collection as a baseline, then builds internal skills on top of it.
The author uses the free repo as a funnel into paid courses and workshops (their existing business model).

money_ideas.idea: The author's own model — free skills as a funnel into paid TypeScript courses and workshops — is the proven playbook here.

steal_this: If you have niche expertise (e.g. Django, iOS, DevOps), publish your own curated skills repo this weekend as a lead magnet into a paid course or newsletter, exactly like this author does.
